title: Fugle connected material-disclosure source capability audit
positiveEvidence: 2537 latest fire disclosure can be replayed exactly by target_id 6ac0814f9e92b0f406eceda0.
2537 2026-08-04 correction disclosure can be replayed independently by its own target_id, showing the correction exists as an additional item rather than silently replacing the earlier disclosure.
The MOPS URL embeds issuer, spoke_date, spoke_time and sequence context, allowing source-level reconciliation.
Structured descs preserve event facts, issuer impact statements, effective dates and correction wording where disclosed.
counterevidence: timestamp_start query returned only contentId metadata in this test and did not return rawContent; incremental retrieval semantics are therefore not yet proven.
An older target_id replay serialized _id as a binary/object structure while newer replay returned a string; stable identifier serialization across vintages is not yet guaranteed.
The content-spec inventory exposes material disclosures but no canonical licensed general-news content type.
Provider timestamp is a source/display clock; this audit did not authenticate when the connected source first made the item available to a strategy.
exactNext: Prospectively query a newly arriving disclosure at fixed cadence and freeze connector capturedAt for the first successful appearance.
Retest timestamp_start on a known bounded window and document provider semantics or treat it as unsupported.
Normalize _id serialization before using it as a durable cross-vintage machine identity.
Keep licensed general-news source discovery separate; material disclosures cannot substitute for general news.
